summary: MaintStudent is a web administration interface for managing student records in HSPnet. It provides for searching, displaying, editing, and adding student information, with configurable business rules and field validation based on agency and user roles.
purpose: To allow authorized users to search, view, add, edit, and manage student records, including handling consent programs, personal information, communication fields, and agency relationships. It enforces data standards, security, and workflow requirements for student administration.

workflows.name: Search Student
steps: User enters search criteria (LastName, FirstName, StudentNumber, Department, Program, Active Users only, Include QES Users).
Validation checks ensure at least one non-wildcard criterion is entered.
System displays student list in grid with sort and paging.
User can clear all search fields.

workflows.name: Add Student
steps: User clicks Add button.
Detail panel opens with editable fields.
Mandatory and regex validators applied to names, emails, and student numbers.
AlternateStudentNumber and PlacingAgency must be supplied together or not at all.
Consent program fields required if first/last name longer than 1 character.
Student number template checked against program.
Duplicate name check performed before insert.
If duplicate detected, prompt is shown; user may confirm to proceed.
Insert creates new record, sets default values, and refreshes grid.

workflows.name: Edit Student
steps: User clicks Edit icon on grid row.
Detail panel opens in edit mode.
Fields populated from selected student.
Validators applied per configuration and user role.
Sysadmins can edit student number; warning displayed if user ID is active.
Save button triggers update after validation.

workflows.name: Delete Student
steps: User clicks Delete icon.
Confirmation prompt if student profile exists.
Student record deleted, grid refreshed.

workflows.name: Switch User
steps: User clicks Switch User icon.
System validates user access and activity.
Successful switch redirects to new session and MaintStudent page.

workflows.name: View Student Profile
steps: User clicks Profile icon.
Depending on consent status and user role, system enables profile view or disables access.
Expired consent can be un-expired by sysadmin.

business_rules: Screen is editable only for SystemAdministrator, LocalAdministrator, or StudentMaint users who are not ViewOnly.
Search requires at least one non-wildcard criterion.
Both AlternateStudentNumber and Agency must be supplied or omitted together.
Consent program and obtained date are mandatory if name fields are specified (longer than 1 character).
Student number must match Consent Program template.
Student number may only be editable by sysadmin; warning if active user ID.
Duplicate name check before insert; prompt shown if duplicates found.
Consent fields hidden for non-admin users if ConsentProgramID exists.
Department may control visibility of DOB based on configuration.
Phone fields validation enabled based on agency configuration.
Email required if HSPnetUser is true.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator and RegularExpressionValidator on LastName, FirstName, MiddleName, PreferredFirstName, Email, StudentNumber, ConsentObtainedDate, ExpectedEndDate, DOB.
Custom validators: validSearchCriteria, validAltStudentNumberAgency, validConsent, checkStudentNumberTemplate, checkPhone, checkAltPhone, checkAltPhone2.
Masked input for phone and area codes.
calculations: Student number template pattern generated per ConsentProgram.
Consent expiry detected by date comparison and housekeeping thresholds.
Consent obtained date highlighted in red if more than 6 years ago.
conditions: If screen is not editable, fields and controls are disabled.
If user is not admin, certain fields (consent, gender, student number) are hidden.
DOB visibility depending on department, configuration, and user role.
Fields defaulted or pre-filled based on agency, program, or prior student selection.
Consent fields disabled if consent expired and user is not sysadmin.
system_behavior: Auto-hide and show panels for error, warning, duplicate names.
Javascript initialized for client-side validation, dropdowns, and masking.
Server-side workflow triggers for all CRUD operations.
Ajax and async postback handling for update panels.
Email messaging via popup and hash URL workflow.
Upload student file panel shown only for editable screens.
dependencies: UserSession: controls access and field visibility.
Departments: used for department filtering and release of DOB info.
Programs: determines student number template and consent requirements.
Agency configuration for phone mask, DOB info visibility, and SSO.
DataLayer for lookups and CRUD operations.
exceptions: Duplicate name prompt blocks insert until confirmed.
Student number template mismatch prevents insert/update.
Consent expired disables certain actions unless sysadmin.
Switch user unavailable if user is inactive or access is denied.
content_gaps: No explicit database schema for Student or program tables.
Exact business logic for CRUD operations is referenced but not fully detailed in retrieved content.
Consent expiry thresholds and housekeeping period constants are not fully specified.
Email uniqueness and specific error handling may be referenced elsewhere.
